description: Nestled in the beating heart of Santa Monica, on the border of Sunset Park and Pico, 1918 11th Street #D is a beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence just 10 blocks from the beach. Offering 923 sq ft of well-designed living space, the home welcomes you with hardwood floors, an updated kitchen with newer appliances and reverse osmosis system, and a bonus laundry room with newer washer/dryer. Both bedrooms are enhanced with blackout blinds, creating peaceful retreats in the heart of the city. Thoughtful updates include a modern electrical panel, newer water heater, and a roof recently completed by the HOA with no current assessments. Set within an intimate 7-residence community, this home provides two side-by-side parking spaces and a boutique sense of privacy. Positioned in a sought-after Santa Monica enclave, just moments from schools, shopping, dining, and the beach, this residence offers the perfect balance of coastal charm, modern comfort, and everyday convenience - an ideal opportunity to enjoy Santa Monica living at its finest.
